title: Japanese Social Media Manager
jobDescription: We are seeking a experienced Japanese social media manager / blogger to join our team for a long term project. As a social media manager, you will be responsible for providing professional social media management services for a leading global game / sports platform. Excellent communication skills in Japanese are a must for this role. If you have a strong command of the Japanese language and enjoy working with people around the globe, we would love to hear from you. This is a great opportunity to work with a dynamic and diverse team in a fast-paced environment.
